claim: Q25022 maps to one modern locus with a visible margin
finding: 99.55 % / 2 diffs to HCON_00043670 vs 94.20 % / 26 to HCON_00005260; next two loci 90.62 % and 87.50 %

claim: the 2-residue difference is allelic, not paralogous
finding: M76491 vs HCON_00043670 CDS 98.52 % (20 diffs, 18 synonymous) vs 79.36 % to HCON_00005260 (278 diffs); M76493 and EF198865 reciprocal
confidence: high; cannot exclude an unannotated ~99 % identical duplicate

claim: the two candidates are genuinely separate loci
finding: 8/8 shared junction positions, no shared intron length (r=0.456), spans 5132 vs 3712 nt; isotype-2 lacks the CDS nt 1278 intron

claim: orthology can name the chr X genes but cannot pick the drug target
finding: HCON_00164580 = tbb-4 (98.65 %), HCON_00167340 = mec-7 (96.15 %); isotype-1 and isotype-2 co-orthologs of ben-1/tbb-1/tbb-2, margins 0.64-1.33 pp
context: six C. elegans beta-tubulin UniProt entries
confidence: high for the chr X calls; explicitly negative for isotype-1 vs isotype-2

claim: which chromosome carries isotype-1 vs isotype-2
finding: clear selection signature on chr I centred on isotype-1; weak 3.3 Mbp chr II region containing isotype-2
context: four field populations, same reference assembly
confidence: high for chromosomal assignment; chr II signal too broad to implicate isotype-2

claim: beta 12-16 and beta 8-9 are different isotype classes
finding: beta 8-9 differs extensively in the carboxyterminus; 12 of 26 Q25022-vs-isotype-1 diffs fall in residues 433-446

claim: which locus the field's isotype 1 and isotype 2 sequences belong to
finding: isotype-1-labelled records 0-2 diffs from HCON_00005260; isotype-2-labelled 0-1 from HCON_00043670; no overlap
confidence: high as convention anchor; database level

claim: database naming of the four loci
finding: HCON_00043670 = tbb-isotype-2; HCON_00005260 = tub8-9; chr X genes tbb-isotype-3 / tbb-isotype-4
confidence: medium; not independent of the sequence result

claim: which gene the resistance codons belong to
finding: BZ resistance primarily associated with isotype-1 beta-tubulin point mutations at codons 167, 198, 200
confidence: high as field consensus; review level

claim: is there any primary evidence on the isotype-2 gene product?
finding: 12/12 papers retrieved by an isotype-2-targeted query genotype isotype-1 only; no isotype-2 genotype, expression, knockdown or locus-level scan
confidence: high for the asymmetry; older isotype-2 deletion work not reachable via this interface

finding: no complete isotype-2 model; best match a 514-aa fragmented isotype-1-like gene with 66 gap columns
